WHO WE ARE

Different ways of seeing.
One team around the work.

Researchers and operators, working together from the first question.

Koralli is a research-led consulting practice bringing together Oxford researchers and senior operators. Our specialisms span statistics, computer science, the social sciences and industry. We draw on those differences to understand problems that cross disciplinary boundaries.

MEET THE PEOPLE ↓
01 / THE PEOPLEPROFILES FOR REVIEW

Knowledge from different worlds.

A working set of profiles from the latest team drafts. Names, roles and biographies remain for team review.

01

OPERATIONS & TRANSFORMATION

Antony Turner

Antony brings around 30 years of experience in financial services. His work spans organisational transformation, technology infrastructure, security and delivery, combining operating experience with a focus on how organisations adapt.

02

STATISTICS

Kieran Ayres

Kieran is completing a DPhil in Statistics at Oxford, developing Bayesian inference methods for epidemiology and computational biology. He previously studied health data analytics and machine learning at Imperial and worked in data science at Accenture.

03

COMPUTER SCIENCE

Sophie Fischer

Sophie is completing a DPhil in Computer Science at Oxford. Her work includes computer science research and collaboration with the Oxford Law Faculty on AI in trademark law. She also co-founded the carbon capture startup Cequestre.

04

AI & SOCIETY

Bella Raja

Bella is completing a DPhil at the Oxford Internet Institute, examining the social and environmental implications of AI hardware and infrastructure. Her background spans science, technology and society at Stanford and the social science of the internet at Oxford.

05

HISTORY & INSTITUTIONS

Orla Hogan

Orla is completing a DPhil in History at Oxford, following a BA and MPhil at Cambridge. She brings experience in strategic communications, crisis management and research into corporate practices in financial services.

06

TECHNOLOGY & GOVERNANCE

Emilie Ouwerx

Emilie studied the Social Science of the Internet at Oxford, covering AI regulation, algorithmic bias and digital sovereignty. Her experience includes work on decentralised cloud infrastructure and sustainable risk pool design.

07

BIOLOGY & COMPUTATION

Oakem Kyne

Oakem is completing a DPhil in Biology at Oxford, studying how bacterial pathogens evolve and adapt to antibiotics. His work draws on genetic epidemiology, phylogenetics and machine learning.

03 / WHY KORALLI

An ecosystem
of perspectives.

A reef grows through relationships.

Different organisms contribute to a structure that none could create alone. That is the idea behind Koralli: distinct research disciplines and operating experience working together, with enough shared understanding to build something useful.

The work stays connected from the original question through to what happens in practice.
